ms.promise:
・TxParser (Pallas-based) for decode → edit → rebuild
・APIs to parse transaction CBOR, expose fields for safe mutation, and rebuild a transaction body with a helper that re-balances change and recalculates fees.
・Transaction editing workflow
・Ability to deserialize a transaction, read the relevant fields (e.g., inputs/outputs, metadata, validity interval, required signers), apply user edits, and rebuild with the TxBuilder.
・Port whisky-csl utils to Pallas
・Drop-in replacements for the existing CSL-backed helpers (e.g., key-hash → bech32 address, script hash extraction from Native/Plutus CBOR, DRep ID from key hashes).
・Public release & docs/announcements
・﻿GitHub tag/release with notes summarising the parser/edit/rebuild capability and the utils migration; README examples updated; one X (Twitter) post and one Discord announcement linking to the release and docs.
ms.criteria:
・Round-trip and semantic equivalence
・Deserialize → (no-op) → reserialize is demonstrated by tests to preserve ledger-relevant semantics (same inputs spent, outputs/values, fees, validity interval, mint/burn, withdrawals/certs, required signers, collateral, script integrity, metadata/datum refs). Re-serialization era may differ; semantics must not. No-op tests will include at least a single test that uses each transaction field. Semantic equivalence will be tested by parsing the final cbor with Pallas and inspected. (All tests pass; no panics.)
・Edit & rebuild with automatic balancing
・Tests s
